Name: Semi-Realistic Animal Replacer V1
Author: Crucifigo
Description:
[b]This mod will not be updated as I am making a new improved version.[/b] I don't have all of the original files from this set in one place so some versions seen on the official forum may be missing. Everything available on my Dropbox at time of upload is packaged in this download.

Replaces all of the barn and coop animals as of Stardew Valley 1.0. Backup your files before installing.

Do not redistribute unless making a bug-fix for sprite errors I've missed. You can convert the .png versions into working replacers if one of them is not available to install and redistribute that. Credit me for my work.

Downloads.Description: Recovered files from previous uploads offsite.
